Monthly pay cycle — ~30 days before money lands.
Tight completion deadlines and tests before some shops.

steps: Create a free shopper account on second-to-none.com
Apply specifically for the Foreign-Language Mystery Shopper call program
Complete call shops from home per the scenario instructions
Submit the call/shop report with documentation by deadline
Get paid $20 per report monthly via direct deposit (free) or PayPal ($1 fee)
timing: Paid once monthly via direct deposit or PayPal for all completed/approved shops. PayPal has a $1 processing fee; direct deposit is free.

repeatable.cadence: Claim new call assignments as the program posts them and get $20 per approved call report, month after month.

maximize: If you speak a second language, the foreign-language call shops are the play — $20 a report on the official rate card, doable from home with zero travel. Take direct deposit instead of PayPal and skip the $1 monthly PayPal fee.
who_pays: Second To None pays you directly — an Ann Arbor, Michigan market-research company running compliance telephone audits for a national healthcare brand.
who_qualifies: You must be conversationally fluent in English plus one of Spanish, Cantonese, Korean, Vietnamese, Tagalog, French, Mandarin, or Russian. Open to US and Canada shoppers with a free shopper account; non-US shoppers are paid through PayPal only.
work_available: You apply specifically for the Foreign-Language Mystery Shopper program and take calls from home as assignments come in. Second To None says work is offered assignment by assignment, so there is no guaranteed volume — how many $20 call shops you get depends on the client's current audit needs.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid only after your report is approved. For each call: use broken English to request the interpreter, then speak only your assigned language, follow the pre-defined scenario and ask all the required knowledge questions, then log in and complete the 20-item English questionnaire (yes/no, short answer, commentary — about 15 minutes). If the team follows up with questions about your report, respond promptly — payment is held until clarifications come back.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees — the shopper account is free and Second To None states it never charges shoppers. Unpaid time: creating your profile and passing any pre-shop tests, making each 5–7 minute call, and completing the ~15-minute questionnaire after every call.
when_cash_arrives: Paid once a month for all calls completed the previous month — via direct deposit (free) or PayPal (a $1 processing fee per monthly payment). Non-US shoppers are paid via PayPal only.
